sentences.text: Caryn Mandabach is an American television producer .

Caryn Mandabach produced ground-breaking US hits including The Cosby Show , Roseanne , A Different World -LRB- 1990 -- 1993 -RRB- , Grace Under Fire -LRB- 1993 -- 1998 -RRB- , Cybill -LRB- 1995 -- 1998 -RRB- , 3rd Rock from the Sun -LRB- 1997 -- 2001 -RRB- , That '80s Show -LRB- 2002 -RRB- , That '70s Show -LRB- 1998 -- 2004 -RRB- , and Grounded for Life -LRB- 2001 -- 2005 -RRB- .	The Cosby Show	The Cosby Show	Roseanne	Roseanne (TV series)	A Different World	A Different World	Grace Under Fire	Grace Under Fire (TV series)	Cybill	Cybill	3rd Rock from the Sun	3rd Rock from the Sun	That '80s Show	That '80s Show	That '70s Show	That '70s Show	Grounded for Life	Grounded for Life

Most recently she executive produced Nurse Jackie , with Linda Wallem and Liz Brixius , a half-hour dark comedy about a `` flawed '' emergency room nurse in a New York City hospital , starring Edie Falco .	Nurse Jackie	Nurse Jackie	Linda Wallem	Linda Wallem	Liz Brixius	Liz Brixius	dark comedy	black comedy	New York City	New York City

Mandabach currently operates TV production companies on both sides of the Atlantic , where she is actively developing both drama and comedy series for BBC , including the BBC2 period drama Peaky Blinders , Channel 4 , and HBO .	Peaky Blinders	Peaky Blinders (TV series)
Mandabach has won an Emmy award and has also been honoured by The Producer 's Guild , Women in Film and the Hollywood Radio and Television Society among others .
